'''2019 European Championship Day 3 Chris Menzel LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2019 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Senate Menzel LS 2019 EC 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141514/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
